cases.mechanism_detail: Sequence characterisation of a previously reported full-length L1 inserted into the beta-globin gene; shown to be retrotransposition-competent in HeLa cells. Disease mechanism not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: Here we report the nucleotide sequences of the two full-length L1 elements, L1beta-thal and L1RP, that have inserted into the beta-globin and retinitis pigmentosa-2 (RP2) genes, respectively.

cases.mechanism_detail: Sequence characterisation of a previously reported full-length L1 inserted into RP2; L1RP was the most active L1 isolated in the retrotransposition assay. Disease mechanism not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: Here we report the nucleotide sequences of the two full-length L1 elements, L1beta-thal and L1RP, that have inserted into the beta-globin and retinitis pigmentosa-2 (RP2) genes, respectively.
